items.name: Geometry and measurement
items.basis: Executed in an offline container: line/circle/rectangle/arc/polyline created headless, saved and re-opened with ezdxf (line end [30,40] exact); a HATCH over a closed rectangle reopens with pattern ANSI31 and scale 2.0; over MCP stdio a create_line returns requested/actual/diff and the saved DXF reopens with the line at (0,0)-(50,0); a negative radius is rejected over MCP (E_PARAMETER_REJECTED), a missing layer returns E_LAYER_NOT_FOUND, and a bad handle is refused.
items.scope_and_limits: Measurement is absent headless: entity_get returns no length/area for line, circle, rectangle, arc or polyline, and the HATCH readback has no area (probe F1-measure, all null). create_hatch takes a single boundary so islands are not expressible headless. The backend API itself accepts radius -5 and NaN coordinates (only the MCP layer validates). Change from first pass: none in score; evidence is now executed rather than historical.

deduction.reason: Withhold 3: length/area/topology measurement returns nothing headless, no islands; COM measurement unexecutable here.

items.name: Editing
items.basis: Executed: move (5,5) then rotate 90 then scale 2 gives a line at (-10,10)-(-10,30) as computed by hand; mirror and a 2x3 array produce 7 lines in the reopened DXF; moving a bad handle is refused. offset and fillet are refused headless with explicit 'not supported' errors (honest refusal).
items.scope_and_limits: Offset/fillet/chamfer/trim/extend/break/join exist only on the COM/LISP path, which cannot run here, so they stay at their first-pass (code-only) level. No requirement-driven editing. Change from first pass: 1 -> 2 because the headless editing path now has executed, independently re-read output evidence.

deduction.reason: Withhold 3: half of the item (trim/join/offset/fillet) is COM-only and unexecuted; no requirement-driven changes.

items.name: Annotation/styles
items.basis: Executed: a linear dimension between (0,0) and (37.5,0) reopens with measurement 37.5 and rendered block text '37,5'.
items.scope_and_limits: Ordinary dimensions work, but dimension/text styles, numeric tolerances and fits are absent from the tool surface on every backend, and the headless rendered text uses a comma decimal separator with no style control. Change from first pass: none; the absent key capability keeps the item at 1.

deduction.reason: No styles/tolerances/fits capability.

items.name: Organization/exchange
items.basis: Executed: layers, block define (uppercase types), insert with attributes, update_attribute and DXF save/reopen work (reopened TAG=P-102); a missing block is refused.
items.scope_and_limits: block.define silently drops entity definitions whose type is not exactly uppercase CIRCLE/LINE/ATTDEF and still returns ok with entity_count equal to the number requested (probe: reported 2, actual 0); the MCP block tool passes data straight through. A duplicate define raises an uncaught DXFTableEntryError at backend level. No paper-space layouts, viewports or tables on any backend; DWG/PDF COM-only. Change from first pass: none.

deduction.reason: Layouts/viewports/tables absent; block.define false success.

items.name: Domain workflows
items.basis: Executed: pid_setup_layers and pid_list_symbols work headless.
items.scope_and_limits: Defect reproduced: pid_insert_symbol('NO-SUCH-CATEGORY','NO-SUCH-SYMBOL', rotation=45) returns ok=true and the reopened DXF contains only an LWPOLYLINE placeholder and TEXT, no INSERT. No mechanical views/BOM, rooms or takeoff. Change from first pass: none (defect now executed, cap 2 applies).

deduction.reason: P&ID symbol false success reproduced (cap 2); other domain workflows absent.

items.name: Transactions
items.basis: Executed: an atomic headless batch with a missing-layer member returns E_BATCH_ROLLED_BACK, rolls back both created handles and the saved/reopened DXF has 0 entities; an invalid-radius member also rolls back; a non-atomic batch reports failures=1 with the partial entity left and ok=false. Over MCP stdio, a second write with the stale expected_revision is rejected with E_DOCUMENT_REVISION_MISMATCH, a wrong doc_id with E_DOCUMENT_ID_MISMATCH, a missing layer with E_LAYER_NOT_FOUND (entity_created=false), and the idempotency journal records journal_state=committed.
items.scope_and_limits: Headless only. The native worker's database transaction and COM undo marks cannot run here and keep their first-pass level; no undo/checkpoint headless. Saved/reopened postconditions were checked for the rollback, but no cross-process native transaction was. Change from first pass: 2 -> 3 from executed error/boundary evidence with no false success.

deduction.reason: Withhold 2: native/COM transaction paths unexecuted; no checkpoints/undo on the executable backend.

items.scope_and_limits: In-memory headless only; no saved-specification check of a delivered artifact (delivery is COM-only). Change from first pass: 2 -> 3.

declared_contract: Version 4.0.0 fork of puran-water/autocad-mcp: a stdio MCP server with 12 consolidated tools (drawing, entity, solid, product, layer, block, annotation, pid, transaction, view, job, system) that claims checked writes (handle readback, requested/actual diffs, document revisions), 2D drafting, dimensions, topology DRC, native AutoCAD 3D solids and bounded product features, and delivery evidence (DWG/DXF/PDF/PNG, exported-DXF re-audit, manifests, SHA-256). Backends: a .NET 8 native worker over a current-user named pipe for full AutoCAD 2025/2026 (atomic DocumentLock transactions), a File IPC COM/LISP compatibility path for AutoCAD and AutoCAD LT 2024+ (undo-group compensation, explicitly not provably atomic), and a headless ezdxf backend for any platform without delivery, plot, undo, offset/fillet/trim or 3D.

serious_defects.description: mcp_dispatch.lsp dispatches execute-lisp from any command file in the IPC directory (default C:/temp) without its own authorisation and sets SECURELOAD to 0 while loading the referenced file; AUTOCAD_MCP_ALLOW_ARBITRARY_LISP is enforced only in the Python server, so a planted command file yields arbitrary AutoLISP execution. Demonstrated by source reading, not executed. Strict pass: not executable here (runs only inside AutoCAD); remains source-demonstrated.

Headless pid_insert_symbol returns ok=true for a nonexistent category/symbol and writes only a placeholder LWPOLYLINE + TEXT (no INSERT), ignoring rotation; README says the ezdxf backend has built-in CTO support.

block.define (ezdxf, reachable through the MCP block tool unchanged) silently skips entity definitions whose type is not exactly 'CIRCLE', 'LINE' or 'ATTDEF' and returns ok with entity_count equal to the requested count; probe: reported 2, block actually empty.

limitations: Historical green evidence comes from ancestor 2c50d72; it is credited only for headless paths whose code changed trivially since. About 12.7k inserted lines (native worker, File IPC, server, transport) postdate it.
The repository commits no live AutoCAD result files, so native-backend items are capped at 1 by the evidence rule, not because the code was shown to be wrong.
The S1 permission defect assumes the IPC directory is writable by other local processes (default C:/temp); actual ACLs on a given machine were not checked.
Four pull-request CI runs (37082618038, 37082187577, 39402662433, 39402601537) are for later fork branches, not ancestors of the pin, and were not used.
Strict pass executed only the headless ezdxf path and pure-Python modules on Linux/Python 3.12; COM/native items keep their first-pass evidence level.
Windows CI logs for the pinned run expired, so whether its failures match the three Linux platform failures is unknown.
method: strict: pinned source + committed evidence + executed headless tests and probes in an offline Docker container
